title: Update ToolGate template policy to allow github_read (v1.1 read-only)
summary:
Updates the ToolGate template policy (templates/agents/toolgate) to explicitly allow github_read as a read-only tool in v1.1, aligning with SSOT:
- master__tool_unlock_roadmap_v1__addendum_v1_1.md
- master__tool_gate_policy_v1__addendum_v1_1.md

Key changes:
- Add a github_read rule (effect=read) with humanApproved not required.
- Keep blockedWhen.pathsPrefix intact (still relevant for changes/write paths).

Safety:
- Policy change only; no runtime write effects.
- Default-deny remains in effect for unmatched rules.

files.content:
version: toolgate_v1

blockedWhen:
  pathsPrefix:
    - "infra/"
    - "ops/"
    - ".github/"
    - "templates/"
    - "security/"
    - "billing/"

tools:
  - tool: "read_repo"
    effect: "read"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true, false]
      riskLevel: ["low", "medium", "high"]
      highRiskDetected: [true, false]

  - tool: "github_read"
    effect: "read"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true, false]
      riskLevel: ["low", "medium", "high"]
      highRiskDetected: [true, false]

  - tool: "schema_validate"
    effect: "validate"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true, false]
      riskLevel: ["low", "medium", "high"]
      highRiskDetected: [true, false]

  - tool: "proposal_validate"
    effect: "validate"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true, false]
      riskLevel: ["low", "medium", "high"]
      highRiskDetected: [true, false]

  - tool: "git_diff"
    effect: "validate"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true, false]
      riskLevel: ["low", "medium", "high"]
      highRiskDetected: [true, false]

  - tool: "ci_check"
    effect: "validate"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true, false]
      riskLevel: ["low", "medium", "high"]
      highRiskDetected: [true, false]

  - tool: "run_tests"
    effect: "validate"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true, false]
      riskLevel: ["low", "medium", "high"]
      highRiskDetected: [true, false]

  - tool: "create_branch"
    effect: "write"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true]
      riskLevel: ["low"]
      highRiskDetected: [false]
      maxFilesTouched: 10

  - tool: "create_pull_request"
    effect: "write"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true]
      riskLevel: ["low"]
      highRiskDetected: [false]
      maxFilesTouched: 10

# ToolGate (v1.0) Template

Policy Engine for tool execution permissioning.
- blockedWhen -> allowedWhen -> default-deny
- optional Bearer auth via TOOLGATE_API_KEY
- policies loaded from TOOLGATE_POLICIES_DIR (default: ./policies)

## Policy notes
- v1.0: read/validate tools allowed; write tools should remain gated.
- v1.1: github_read (read-only) is explicitly allowed in the template policy.

## Run
```bash
cd templates/agents/toolgate
export TOOLGATE_POLICIES_DIR="policies"
# optional:
# export TOOLGATE_API_KEY="change-me"
uvicorn toolgate.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8088
```

## Example
POST /v1/evaluate
```json
{
  "policyVersion": "toolgate_v1",
  "requestId": "req_123",
  "proposalId": "prp_abc",
  "tool": "github_read",
  "effect": "read",
  "context": {
    "humanApproved": false,
    "riskLevel": "low",
    "highRiskDetected": false,
    "pathsTouched": ["README.md"],
    "filesTouchedCount": 1,
    "domains": ["agent"]
  }
}
```

manualSteps: Start ToolGate template and POST /v1/evaluate with tool=github_read,effect=read to confirm allow.
POST /v1/evaluate with pathsTouched including 'infra/x' to confirm deny due to blockedWhen.pathsPrefix.
